feedId.description: Chosen by the caller, 1 to 64 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -. An APPLIED or SUPERSEDED feed is never applied twice.

fullUpdate.description: True for a full feed, the complete truth for its node.

asOf.description: The instant the numbers are true for (feed level, ADR 0002, A12).

lines.description: At most 10000 lines, at most one per listingId; empty only on a full feed.

items.description: One listing's declared availability. The model names lines but does not define them (ADR 0002, A12).

availableQty.description: Must be >= 0, else the feed FAILS with negative-availability.

basis.description: Why the node gave the number; kept as the vendor declared it, never re-derived.
basis.title: Basis

items.title: FeedLine
